items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: And there was another organization down there, Young Men's by Dave.

ctx.x: Any organizations downtown that have funerals or parades?

Well not anymore. See, years ago, Young Men of Liberty used to use music. Perseverance used music. The charity used music. And there was another organization down there, Young Men's by Dave. But you see, Dick, in the later years, old men die out. That's it. The youngsters don't come behind. They just fade out the pictures. They die out. That's the end of it. They used to have big parades on Sunday when those organizations were in bloom. Downtown and uptown. Downtown and uptown also. That's right. They used to…
Well, the organizations mostly smaller than they used to be now or about the same size?
